name: Nie Grassroots Logic
tagline: An agent skill for grassroots socio-economic analysis
description: nie-grassroots-logic is an agent skill rooted in the "Grassroots China" methodology from Nie Huihua's book, turned into a structured socio-economic analysis toolkit. It gives an agent a lens for examining how local institutions, incentives, and social dynamics actually operate at the grassroots level, rather than relying on top-down assumptions. For researchers, analysts, and anyone studying Chinese social and economic behavior, it packages a respected analytical framework into a ready-to-use agent capability.
highlights: Turns Nie Huihua's 'Grassroots China' methodology into an agent skill
A structured toolkit for socio-economic analysis at the local level
Useful for researchers and analysts studying Chinese social dynamics
Another sign of the maturing non-English agent-skill ecosystem
curatorNote: Encoding a serious analytical framework into an agent skill is a clever idea, and Grassroots China is a strong fit for it. Fascinating to see academic methodology become a reusable agent capability this fast.
